judge.reason: q1: The diff adds an optional `giftWrap` flag to `placeOrder`, which passes it to `price`. When the flag is set, `price` adds a flat 450-cent fee once per order. The fee is added after tax is worked out on the discounted merchandise, so it is not taxed, and it is included in the total. New tests in pricing.test.ts and checkout.test.ts check the fee, that tax is unchanged, and the total, receipt amount and audit amount. The existing pricing test was also updated for the new `giftWrap` field. q2: The final answer names R-GIFT-WRAP by its ID and calls it new and draft.

finalMessage:
Gift wrapping is available as an optional checkout choice. It adds **$4.50 once per order** to the quote and charge, after discounts and sales tax are calculated. The quote shows the fee separately.

`npm test` passed all 38 tests. `ostf check --base main` passed with no errors; it reported two pre-existing unlinked items.

The trace check lists **R-GIFT-WRAP** (new, draft), **R-CHECKOUT-ORDER**, **R-CHECKOUT-SESSION**, and **R-TAX-RATE**; the change keeps each true. It also lists their parent needs **N-BUY** and **N-FAIR-PRICE**, which remain true. No risk-relevant item was touched. The listed tests are `Checkout > places an order`, `needs a valid session`, `charges gift wrapping once when requested at checkout`; `price > taxes the subtotal after discounts`, `adds untaxed gift wrapping after merchandise discount and tax`; and `tax > rounds half up to the cent`.
